mapper.select: select FCI.CASH_ID cashId, FCI.FEE_ID feeId, MF.FEE_TYPE feeType, MF.BASIC_BILL basicBill, MF.BASIS basis, FCCR.YIELD * 100 feeRate, FCCR.BASE_DATE_TYPE netAssetValueDay, MF.CHARGE_TYPE chargeType from FIN_CASH_INFO FCI, MST_FEEINFO MF, FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE FCCR, FIN_PRODUCT FP WHERE FCI.FEE_ID = MF.FEE_ID and FCI.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID and FCI.CASH_ID = FCCR.CASH_ID and (FCCR.EFF_DATE = FP.VDATE OR FP.FINPROD_TYPE2=#{finprodType2}) and FCI.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and FCI.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1} and MF.FEE_TYPE in (#{feeType10}, #{feeType11}, #{feeType99}) and FCI.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType}

select FCI.CASH_ID cashId, FCI.FEE_ID feeId, MF.FEE_TYPE feeType, MF.BASIC_BILL basicBill, MF.BASIS basis, FCPR.END_TDAY_RULE calcFeeTradeRule, FCPR.PAY_TDAY_RULE payFeeTradeRule, FCPR.PAY_CYCLE payFeeRule, FFCR.F_ACCR_DATE provisionFirstDay, FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE.YIELD * 100 feeRate, FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE.BASE_DATE_TYPE netAssetValueDay, FFCR.E_ACCR_DATE eAccrDate, FCPR.FIRST_PAY_DATE firstCalEndDate, MF.CHARGE_TYPE chargeType, FCI.FINPROD_ID finprodId from FIN_CASH_INFO FCI, MST_FEEINFO MF, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE FCPR, (SELECT YIELD,BASE_DATE_TYPE,CASH_ID,EFF_DATE FROM FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE UNION SELECT NULL,BASE_DATE_TYPE,CASH_ID,EFF_DATE FROM FIN_FLOAT_CALC_RULE)FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE, FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE FFCR, FIN_PRODUCT FP WHERE FCI.FEE_ID = MF.FEE_ID and FCI.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID and FCI.CASH_ID = FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE.CASH_ID and (FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE.EFF_DATE = FP.VDATE OR FP.FINPROD_TYPE2=#{finprodType2}) and FCI.CASH_ID = FCPR.CASH_ID and (FCPR.EFF_DATE = FP.VDATE OR FP.FINPROD_TYPE2=#{finprodType2}) and FCI.CASH_ID = FFCR.CASH_ID and (FFCR.EFF_DATE = FP.VDATE OR FP.FINPROD_TYPE2=#{finprodType2}) and FCI.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and FCI.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1} and MF.FEE_TYPE in (#{feeTypeTrust}, #{feeTypeFix}, #{feeTypeSale}, #{feeTypeOthSale}, #{feeTypeThService},#{feeTypeFloat},#{feeTypeInvest}) and FCI.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType}
UNION ALL select FCI.CASH_ID cashId, FCI.FEE_ID feeId, MF.FEE_TYPE feeType, MF.BASIC_BILL basicBill, MF.BASIS basis, FCPR.END_TDAY_RULE calcFeeTradeRule, FCPR.PAY_TDAY_RULE payFeeTradeRule, FCPR.PAY_CYCLE payFeeRule, FFCR.F_ACCR_DATE provisionFirstDay, FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE.YIELD * 100 feeRate, FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE.BASE_DATE_TYPE netAssetValueDay, FFCR.E_ACCR_DATE eAccrDate, FCPR.FIRST_PAY_DATE firstCalEndDate, MF.CHARGE_TYPE chargeType, FCI.FINPROD_ID finprodId from FIN_CASH_INFO FCI, MST_FEEINFO MF, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE FCPR, (SELECT YIELD,BASE_DATE_TYPE,CASH_ID,EFF_DATE FROM FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE UNION SELECT NULL,BASE_DATE_TYPE,CASH_ID,EFF_DATE FROM FIN_FLOAT_CALC_RULE)FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE, FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE FFCR, FIN_PRODUCT FP WHERE FCI.FEE_ID = MF.FEE_ID and FCI.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID and FCI.CASH_ID = FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE.CASH_ID and (FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE.EFF_DATE = FP.VDATE OR FP.FINPROD_TYPE2=#{finprodType2}) and FCI.CASH_ID = FFCR.CASH_ID and (FCPR.EFF_DATE = FP.VDATE OR FP.FINPROD_TYPE2=#{finprodType2}) and FCI.CASH_ID = FFCR.CASH_ID and (FFCR.EFF_DATE = FP.VDATE OR FP.FINPROD_TYPE2=#{finprodType2}) and FP.P_FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and FCI.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1} and MF.FEE_TYPE in (#{feeTypeTrust}, #{feeTypeFix}, #{feeTypeSale}, #{feeTypeOthSale}, #{feeTypeThService},#{feeTypeFloat},#{feeTypeInvest}) and FCI.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType}

select distinct FCI.FEE_ID feeId, MF.FEE_TYPE feeType, MF.BASIC_BILL basicBill, MF.BASIS basis, FCPR.PAY_CYCLE payFeeRule, FCPR.END_TDAY_RULE calcFeeTradeRule, FCPR.PAY_TDAY_RULE payFeeTradeRule, FCCR.YIELD * 100 feeRate, FFCR.F_ACCR_DATE provisionFirstDay, FCCR.BASE_DATE_TYPE netAssetValueDay, FFCR.E_ACCR_DATE eAccrDate, FCPR.FIRST_PAY_DATE firstCalEndDate, MF.CHARGE_TYPE chargeType from FIN_CASH_INFO FCI, MST_FEEINFO MF, PTL_MANAGE_OBJ PMO, FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE FCCR, FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE FFCR, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE FCPR, FIN_PRODUCT FP left join prd_layer_param PLP on FP.FINPROD_ID = PLP.FINPROD_ID WHERE FCI.FEE_ID = MF.FEE_ID and FCI.FINPROD_ID = PMO.MANAGE_OBJ_ID and FCI.CASH_ID = FCCR.CASH_ID and FCI.CASH_ID = FFCR.CASH_ID and FCI.CASH_ID = FCPR.CASH_ID and FCI.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID and PMO.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{ptlId} and FCI.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1} and MF.FEE_TYPE in (#{feeTypeTrust}, #{feeTypeFix}, #{feeTypeSale}, #{feeTypeOthSale}, #{feeTypeThService},#{feeTypeInvest}) and FCI.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType}
and FCI.BRANCH = #{branch}

SELECT ACCT_NO acctNo, CCY ccy, BUSI_ACCT_NO busiAcctNo, ACCT_NAME acctName, BANK_DEP bankDep, IN_OUT_BANK inOutBank, CORR_NO corrNo, LARGE_PAYNO largePayno, SWIFT_CODE swiftCode, BLN_AREA blnArea, IS_OVERDRAW isOverdraw, REMARK remark FROM STL_CAPACCT_INFO WHERE ACCT_NO = #{acctNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND CCY = #{ccy,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT T1.CASH_ID, T3.BASE_TYPE basicBill, T3.BASIS, T1.COLLECT_TYPE FROM FIN_CASH_INFO T1 INNER JOIN MST_FEEINFO T2 ON T1.FEE_ID = T2.FEE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T4 ON T4.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE T3 ON T3.CASH_ID = T1.CASH_ID AND T3.EFF_DATE = T4.VDATE WHERE T1.CASH_TYPE_2 in ('C11','C12','C13') AND T1.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND T2.FEE_ID = #{feeId}
